# f5xc_alert_receiver (Resource)

AlertReceiver resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "f5xc_alert_receiver" "example" {
  name      = "example_alert_receiver"
  namespace = "example_namespace"
  receiver_choice = {
    opsgenie = {
      opsgenie = "example_opsgenie"
    }
  }
}
```
